'''Atlas Corp''' was a corporation specialized in armor accessory, such as [[Heat shield/Legends|heat shielding]], [[Heating system/Legends|heating system]], [[Enhanced optics suite/Legends|enhanced optics suite]], [[Strength enhancing system/Legends|strength enhancing system]], or [[Optical camouflage system/Legends|optical camouflage system]].
